briefTitle: Impact of Circadian Rhythm on Immunotherapy

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Cohort A: Advanced/metastatic NSCLC patients for which 1st line PD-1/PD-L1 therapy is on-label either alone or in combination. Cohort B: Advanced/metastatic NSCLC patients who have completed up to 4 cycles of induction therapy who have stable disease or responsive disease and for which maintenance anti-PD-1/PD-L1 therapy is on-label either alone or in combination.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Cohort-specific indication and prior therapy requirements are complex and cannot be captured in simple typed checks.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patients should be ICI-naïve (this should be first-line therapy) (Cohorts A and C), or should have received ICI induction therapy and are now eligible for ICI maintenance therapy (Cohort B).
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior ICI status differs by cohort and is tied to specific treatment phases, so it cannot be expressed with a single typed prior_therapy_required or prior_therapy_excluded check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Must be willing to be randomized to complete therapy at assigned time of day, which may be early in the morning OR later in the day/into the evening.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Willingness to be randomized to a time of day is a behavioral requirement, not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Must be eligible to receive anti-PD-1/PD-L1 therapy singly or in combination with other FDA-approved agents according to standard of care practices, as determined by the clinical judgment of the investigator but according to approved label indications
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Investigator judgment of standard of care eligibility is subjective.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Must have the ability to understand and the willingness to sign a written informed consent document. Able to read and write in English.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Informed consent and language ability are subjective administrative criteria.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participant unable to receive anti-PD-1/PD-L1 therapy due to prior allergic reactions to therapy or any therapy ingredients.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Allergic reactions and therapy contraindications are investigator judgment-based exclusions.
